premises.text: Illnesses spread silently for weeks because detection waits for symptoms and manual PCR of individuals
premises.evidence_span: it takes weeks to detect illnesses, because many people don't even show symptoms. This means that illnesses are moving silently amongst us

premises.text: Sewage surveillance can measure a whole community in one test, including asymptomatic/pre-symptomatic cases at high sensitivity
premises.evidence_span: You measure a whole community with a single test. Even better, you can detect illnesses right from the beginning of infection, if they're symptomatic, asymptomatic, or pre-symptomatic. Best yet, you can detect one sick person in 10,000 people

premises.text: Manual sewage sampling and lab analysis is too slow and costly (~week, ~$1,000), limiting use to desperate government need
premises.evidence_span: the data could take up to a week and cost up to $1,000. It's too expensive. And it means when an organization like the CDC gets their data, it's already too late

premises.text: Plug-and-play automated hardware/software installs in buildings and automates gold-standard sewage workflow (filtration, RNA extraction, continuous qPCR) for up to 12 pathogens
premises.evidence_span: plug-and-play automated end-to-end hardware and software solution that can be installed into any and every building. Our product can detect up to 12 pathogens

premises.text: Same-day dashboard insights let care homes, offices, and factories act on pathogen risk before outbreaks
premises.evidence_span: This data is sent directly to customers that day. This means that data can go directly to organizations that need it most. Care homes, offices, factories, and so much more

premises.text: Aggregated multi-site sewage data guides preventative healthcare, insurance, and public-health policy beyond single buildings
premises.evidence_span: Those data insights can be used to guide preventative healthcare solutions, insurance policy, public health policy, and so, so much more

domains.name: Silent spread and manual sewage limits

value.text: Earlier detection of community illness without testing every person, enabling outbreak prevention
value.evidence_span: providing a better way without testing whole communities

causal_links.evidence_span: there has to be a better way of detecting illnesses
detecting more illnesses than ever before from sewage

notes: Three hardware stages (filtration keeping dirty fraction, RNA extraction, continuous qPCR) and patents folded into P4 as process+performance package / feature cascade of one automation mechanism. Cruise ships/schools/AMR/cancer mentions treated as application cascade of same detection capability, not separate premises. Market-size figures excluded as framing/traction.
